abstract: Peritoneal glial implants are found in childhood, adolescence as well as in young women and are the result of a ruptured capsule of mature or immature teratoma of the ovary. The implants of glia nodules have a distinct gross feature and are localized mostly in the parietal and visceral peritoneum, in the omentum and in the space of Douglas. According to the review by Robboy and Scully (1970), seventeen other cases have been reported. CASE REPORT: A ten year old girl was operated on for a benign cystic teratoma of the right ovary. After an interval of 12-13 years, two laparotomies were performed because of recurring pains, adhesions of the abdomen and the formation of tumor-shaped resistances. Biopsies from both operations taken from the peritoneum, omentum and space of Douglas yielded disseminated gliomatosis and endometriosis. The uniqueness of this case lies in the length of the interval of 12 years after the operation, the size of the gliomatosis-tumor in the pelvis as well as its regressive changes. X-ray examination of this tissue revealed diffuse calcification. A partially infiltrative growth of the glial mass into fat tissue was determined despite the low grading of the implant. The size of the tumor-like infiltration can be understood as a result of growth and confluence of several nodes. As an expression of a local defense reaction, there was found at one location on the circumference of a glial node an intense lymphofollicular infiltration. The combination of gliomatosis and endometriosis has not been observed up until now. The formation of endometriod glands could be the result of a metaplasia of the subcoelomic mesenchyme. Peritoneal gliomatosis can be considered to be implantation metastases of ovarian teratoma with varying degrees of maturity.
abstract_ja: 腹膜の神経膠組織の播種は小児期、思春期、および若年女性にみられ、卵巣の成熟または未熟奇形腫の被膜破綻の結果として生じる。神経膠結節の肉眼的所見は特徴的で、主に壁側および臓側腹膜、大網、ダグラス窩に局在する。Robboy と Scully(1970)の総説によれば、他に17例が報告されている。症例報告：10歳の女児が右卵巣の良性嚢胞性奇形腫の手術を受けた。12〜13年の経過後、持続する疼痛、腹部の癒着、骨盤内の腫瘤様抵抗の形成のため、2回の開腹術が施行された。両手術で腹膜、大網、ダグラス窩から採取された生検では、播種性の神経膠腫症と子宮内膜症が認められた。本症例の特異性は、術後12年という長い経過、骨盤内の神経膠腫様腫瘤の大きさ、そして退縮性変化にある。このX線検査では組織にびまん性の石灰化が認められた。神経膠組織の塊は、低悪性度の病変であるにもかかわらず、脂肪組織への部分的な浸潤性増殖を示した。腫瘍様浸潤の大きさは、複数の結節の増大と融合の結果と理解できる。局所的防御反応として、神経膠結節の周囲の一箇所に強いリンパ濾胞性浸潤が認められた。神経膠腫症と子宮内膜症の併存はこれまで観察されていない。子宮内膜腺の形成は、漿膜下間葉の化生の結果と考えられる。腹膜神経膠腫症は、様々な成熟度の卵巣奇形腫からの播種性転移と考えることができる。
